metadata.purpose: Global content-safety filter for AI-generated USER-FACING TEXT (recipe cards, captions, shopping lists). Imagery avoids text (in_image_text stays false), so this gate is a text-layer concern. check_text() matches these terms word-boundary, case-insensitive.
metadata.scope: text-layer only; generated imagery carries no text
metadata.match_semantics: word-boundary, case-insensitive; multi-word entries match as a phrase
metadata.extension_note: slurs is intentionally a short conceptual seed — extend from a maintained hate-term list (e.g. an internal moderation list) at deploy time rather than expanding it here in source. profanity is a standard corporate-safe seed.

corporate_tone_notes.included_from_bryan_standards: banned verbal ticks (absolutely, actually, literally, unfortunately) per english-writing-standards; coded-history words (master, spearheaded) per no-coded-language rule; hype words (game-changer, revolutionary, synergy, world-class) as corporate-inappropriate marketing filler.
corporate_tone_notes.excluded_as_too_personal_for_corporate: lowercase-only rule (corporate uses standard capitalization), swear-emoji exception (corporate = zero emoji, no exception), no-period-on-bullets stylistic quirk, slug-friendly ascii heading rule, future-facing-tense preference — these are Bryan's personal-voice quirks, not corporate blockers.
